$comment: Advisories consciously accepted, each with the reason it cannot affect this
app and a date by which someone must look again. Anything not listed here
fails the build. Adding an entry is a decision, not a workaround - if the
reason does not still hold at reviewBy, upgrade instead of extending it.

allow.reason: Affects React Router's RSC mode, where a server action can run before a 400 response. This app uses React Router only as a client-side URL matcher: <BrowserRouter> with <Routes>/<Route>, no createBrowserRouter, no RouterProvider, no route loaders or actions, no useFetcher, no React Router <Form>, and no server rendering. The vulnerable code path is not shipped. npm's suggested remediation is a downgrade to 7.11.0, which would reintroduce the open-redirect and XSS advisories affecting react-router 6.0.0-7.17.0 - and those ARE reachable from <Link> and useNavigate. Staying on 7.18.2 is strictly the safer position.
